title: Cormack-Lehane Classification

changelog.change: Initial entry — the modified 5-grade scheme. Cross-linked from the Airway Management Flow.

purpose: Standardised language for the laryngoscopic view actually obtained — for documentation and handoff, not prediction.

tiers.label: Grade 2b
tiers.description: Only the posterior glottis / arytenoids visible

tiers.label: Grade 3
tiers.description: Only the epiglottis seen, no glottis

interpretation.label: Grades 2b-4 correspond to increasing intubation difficulty
interpretation.detail: Record alongside the number of attempts, devices used, tube size and depth. Grade 3-4 warrants a note of the successful rescue technique.
